name: Sihon
summary: A king of the Amorites who ruled from Heshbon. When he refused to let Israel pass through his land and attacked them, Israel defeated him and took his land.

key_moments.title: Refuses to Let Israel Pass
key_moments.description: Israel sent messengers asking to pass along the king's highway without touching his fields, vineyards or wells. Sihon refused, gathered all his people and came out to fight Israel at Jahaz.

key_moments.title: Loses His Land to Israel
key_moments.description: Israel defeated him and took his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, taking every Amorite city as well. Heshbon was his city, and he had once taken that land from the former king of Moab.
